content: Hono 4.x is a TypeScript-native, ultrafast web framework built on Web Standards (fetch API, Request/Response). It runs on Node.js via @hono/node-server (requires Node.js 20+), and can later deploy to Cloudflare Workers, Vercel, Netlify, and other runtimes without code changes. 4.1x faster than Express. Includes built-in CORS, logger, JWT, and other middleware. Install: npm i hono @hono/node-server
